name: Frase
tagline: SEO/GEO content platform for research, briefs, optimization, and AI writing

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Starter listed at $49/month month-to-month or $39/month billed yearly.

verdictSummary: A content-brief generator over SERP pages and an LLM is reachable, but Frase's workflow combines SERP retrieval, scoring, editor UX, AI-search tracking, and reporting.
coreLoopDIY: Retrieve top pages, summarize topics/questions/headings, generate a brief, score a draft against terms, and export to a doc.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because writers need a repeatable research/editor workflow, not a pile of scraped pages.

priorArt.desc: Open-source enterprise search/answering app; not a Frase clone, but prior art for retrieva

notes: Good final row because it is exactly the sort of buildable-but-work SaaS this site should unpack.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Frase (SEO/GEO content platform for research, briefs, optimization, and AI writing). Requirements:

- Core loop: Retrieve top pages, summarize topics/questions/headings, generate a brief, score a draft against terms, and export to a doc.
- Needs: SERP/search API.
- Needs: web parser.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: document/editor UI.
- Needs: scoring logic.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: SERP data pipeline; optimization scoring; team workflows.
